verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Gitea runs on a Raspberry Pi 3, supports Linux, Windows, macOS, FreeBSD and Kubernetes on x86, amd64, ARM, RISC-V 64 and PowerPC, and integrates with SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL, TiDB and MS SQL. Several hands-on community reports confirm low-resource operation on a $5 VPS, an Atom-based fitlet2 and a 4GB RAM host. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the multiple database backends, which are evidenced only by a marketing-page claim.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can run a self-hosted instance on low-resource hardware across multiple OSes, CPU architectures, and database backends

citations.quote: A Raspberry Pi 3 is powerful enough to run Gitea for small workloads.
it works across all the platforms and architectures that are supported by Go, including Linux, macOS, FreeBSD/OpenBSD and Windows on x86, amd64, ARM, RISC-V 64 and PowerPC
Offers seamless integration with leading databases, including SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL, TiDB, and MS SQL.
Runs Gitea on a $5 VPS for all personal projects and says it works great
